body:
#2619 (BUG-2010, agy) r1: REQUEST CHANGES at 87d654ba66 (fresh STANDARD reviewer; unrecorded, grant expired). The full text is posted on the PR. In short:
- B1: the ancestor-agent walk matches every registered Claude session, so drain phase-child leases get the Claude pid. That breaks the BUG-1930 predecessor check and drain SIGTERM stamping, and crashed lanes read Live.
- B2: session_start rewrites the registry record of the operator or a peer, unlocked.
- B3: the loose OR matcher revives dead project-root harness leases.
- B4: there is no session_start/leases test, and the spec-ID checks are mutation-dead.
Please route it to the agy factory for rework. Also, #2614 r4 STRICT, #2602 r3 STRICT and #2620 reviewers are running now.
subject: #2619 REQUEST CHANGES (4 blockers): route to factory
